title: Learning Perception to Action Rules through Reinforcement Learning for Theory-of-Mind Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19796v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In Theory-of-Mind (ToM) reasoning, large language models may correctly infer the agent's mental state but fail to use that inference when predicting or judging the agent's subsequent actions. In this work, we investigate whether explicitly connecting perception, belief, and action with rules improves ToM reasoning. We generate concise \textit{if--then} rules that express relations between perception to action and use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to train Qwen2.5 and Llama3 models across four ToM benchmarks. GRPO with rule generation outperforms prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and think reasoning. Moreover, rules generated by larger models ($\geq$3B) provide transferable knowledge that improves downstream performance of GPT-4o-mini. These findings suggest that explicit rules help models bridge the reasoning gap in ToM and support knowledge transfer across models.

translated_title: 通过强化学习学习感知到行动的规则以实现心智理论推理
translated_abstract: 在心智理论推理中，大语言模型可能能够正确推断智能体的心理状态，但在预测或判断智能体的后续行动时却未能利用这一推断。在本工作中，我们研究通过规则显式地连接感知、信念与行动是否能改进心智理论推理。我们生成简洁的“如果-那么”规则来表达感知与行动之间的关系，并使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）在四个心智理论基准上训练Qwen2.5和Llama3模型。带规则生成的GRPO优于提示方法、监督微调和思维推理。此外，由较大模型（参数量不低于30亿）生成的规则提供了可迁移的知识，能够提升GPT-4o-mini的下游性能。这些发现表明，显式规则有助于模型弥合心智理论推理中的推理鸿沟，并支持跨模型的知识迁移。
tldr: 本文提出利用GRPO强化学习让模型学习显式的“感知到行动”规则来改进大语言模型的心智理论推理，其效果超越提示、监督微调和思维推理方法，且所生成的规则可作为可迁移知识提升其他模型（如GPT-4o-mini）的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper uses GRPO reinforcement learning to train large language models to learn explicit perception-to-action rules for improved Theory-of-Mind reasoning, outperforming prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and think reasoning, while the learned rules serve as transferable knowledge that boosts downstream performance of other models such as GPT-4o-mini.
